sanskrit: मामुपेत्य पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयमशाश्वतम् । नाप्नुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिद्धिं परमां गताः ॥
hindiTranslation: महात्मालोग मुझे प्राप्त करके दुःखालय और अशाश्वत पुनर्जन्मको प्राप्त नहीं होते क्योंकि वे परमसिद्धिको प्राप्त हो गये हैं अर्थात् उनको परम प्रेमकी प्राप्ति हो गयी है ॥
englishTranslation: Great souls who reach me do not return to this painful, temporary cycle of birth.
essence: True arrival ends the need to come back.
speaker: Krishna
simpleMeaning: Those who reach Krishna do not come back into the painful cycle of birth and death. They have reached the highest fulfillment.
simpleInsight: Reaching Krishna ends the cycle of painful, temporary births for good.
detailedMeaning: Krishna says that great souls who reach him do not return to this painful, temporary world because they have reached the highest fulfillment.
modernRelevance: You pay off the house loan after twenty years and feel the relief, then a new worry moves in. Krishna speaks of a reaching that ends the round of return for good.
translationLiteral: माम् (me) / उपेत्य (having attained) / पुनर्जन्म (rebirth) / दुःखालयम् (abode of suffering) / अशाश्वतम् (impermanent) / नाप्नुवन्ति (do not attain) / महात्मानः (great souls) / संसिद्धिम् (perfect fulfillment) / परमाम् (supreme) / गताः (having reached)
insight: Great souls who reach Krishna never return to birth, which he calls a temporary home of pain.

quoteVariants.text: Reach me, and birth no longer returns as suffering.
The cycle breaks where the supreme is reached.
